title: Food Web Ecology
description: Characterizing food web interactions is fundamental to ecology. Provides a comprehensive introduction to the most important methods used to characterize food web interactions in terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems. Topics include: isotopic ecology, ecological stoichiometry, nutritional geometry, lipid tracers and molecular tracers.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of BIOL 468, BIOL 470 (if taken in the same topic).
